statement: The recorded 12,000 mg acetaminophen dose is unsafe and likely erroneous, so I will not administer it; the order requires urgent prescriber/pharmacy clarification.
judge_text:
WRONG
"The recorded 12,000 mg acetaminophen dose is unsafe and likely erroneous, so I will not administer it" directly asserts the value is wrong.
